# Velair 1.9.0-beta.5

This beta adds Supply control for shared heating and cooling outputs, expands support for climates with range targets, and fixes Profile editing.

## ✨ Added

- **Supply control** can operate a shared heating or cooling switch from the estimated demand of selected thermostats. Configure hysteresis per supply, optional thermostat overrides, minimum-off time and switch-off delay. When Room Assist controls a thermostat, its committed demand takes precedence.
- Switching a supply off manually suspends automatic control until explicitly resumed. If Velair reverses an external activation because no thermostat requests supply, a persistent Home Assistant notification and Activity entry explain the action and reason, with repeated notices limited per supply. Suggested in the [Home Assistant community discussion](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/velair-local-first-climate-scheduling-for-home-assistant-climates/1015394/71).

## 🚀 Improved

- Per-climate target-format settings support devices with different temperature controls in each HVAC mode. Schedules, Profiles, templates, presets, Boost and manual controls preserve the appropriate single target or complete range.
- Supply control includes responsive editing, field-specific save errors and an interactive hysteresis example for heating and cooling, with Celsius and Fahrenheit support.
- Updated interface translations and affected guides across all nine maintained languages, including the new [Shared climate supply guide](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/blob/v1.9.0-beta.5/docs/user/shared-climate-supply.md).

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Climates that require lower and upper setpoints in Heat, Cool or Auto can now be scheduled without requiring a Heat/Cool mode. Room Assist and advance preparation for range targets remain limited to Heat/Cool; other range modes apply their configured targets at the scheduled time or arrival. Thanks to **@Glooob-domo** for [issue #51](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/51).
- Profile editors remain responsive on mobile and reopen correctly when a zone uses a Profile schedule, including browsers without the legacy `window.external` object. Thanks to **@toshi903** for [issue #50](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/50).
- Planned Return climate icons align with the climate name when descriptions or names wrap.

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.4](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.4). Supply demand is an estimate, not confirmation that equipment is heating or cooling. An enabled supply gives Velair control of its switch; avoid competing automations for the same output.
- Portable exports now use model version **22**. Older backups remain importable, but older Velair versions cannot import new model-22 exports. Keep a pre-update backup if you may downgrade. Imported supplies start disabled and suspended: review their settings, enable and save them, then explicitly resume control.
- Translations are AI-assisted and have not received qualified human linguistic review. Physical-device, native Home Assistant theme and Companion app validation remain dependent on real-world testing.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app. If the previous interface remains visible, perform a hard refresh or clear the site cache.
